title: rcf init Playwright MCP entry write only when no scope-visible entry exists
purpose: Cover the five ACs on US-1104: signature-based project-scope detection leaves a pre-existing entry alone, the injected probe drives the four downstream branches (none/found/inconclusive/CLI-absent), the distinct 'playwright-rcf' entry has the exact shape, --no-playwright-mcp suppresses the write, and doctor's redundant-entry probe fires only on browser-facing projects.

testCases.description: A pre-existing project-scope Playwright signature leaves .mcp.json untouched and prints the 'left alone' line
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/init-playwright.test.js::init: existing project-scope Playwright signature -> left alone (spec 4.1)

testCases.description: Probe returning 'none' drives the distinct playwright-rcf project-scope write branch
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/init-playwright.test.js::init: fresh project + probe=none -> writes distinctly named playwright-rcf entry

testCases.description: Probe returning 'found' at user scope leaves .mcp.json alone with the 'already registered ... in Claude Code' line
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/init-playwright.test.js::init: probe=found at user scope -> left alone; no project entry written (spec 4.2)

testCases.description: Probe returning 'inconclusive' writes the distinct entry and prints the could-not-probe notice (covers both CLI-absent and unparseable branches via the injected probe result)
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/init-playwright.test.js::init: probe=inconclusive -> writes playwright-rcf entry AND prints the could-not-probe notice (spec 4.3)

testCases.description: The written playwright-rcf entry equals { type:'stdio', command:'npx', args:['-y', '@playwright/mcp@<version>'], env:{} }
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/init-playwright.test.js::init: fresh project + probe=none -> writes distinctly named playwright-rcf entry

testCases.description: --no-playwright-mcp suppresses the write; the probe still runs but no Playwright entry is created
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/init-playwright.test.js::init --no-playwright-mcp: probe still runs, but no Playwright entry is written

testCases.description: playwright-mcp-redundant fires when project + user both declare Playwright on a browser-facing project
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/doctor-playwright.test.js::doctor: playwright-mcp-redundant fires when project + user both declare Playwright (browser-facing only)

testCases.description: playwright-mcp-redundant does NOT fire on an API-only project
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/doctor-playwright.test.js::doctor: playwright-mcp-redundant does NOT fire on an API-only project (spec 4.5)
